title: Container Bookings: Cancellation Fee Bands and Ceilings by Tier
content:
The Container Bookings cancellation fee is priced per container according to how many calendar days remain between the cancellation and the scheduled departure, and it is limited per booking. This card gives the band rates and the per-booking ceiling for all six products, in US dollars.

## Band rates (USD per container) and ceiling (USD per booking)

| Booking product | 14 or more days out | 7 to 13 days out | 3 to 6 days out | 0 to 2 days out | Ceiling per booking |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 150.00 | 250.00 | 350.00 | 450.00 | 2500.00 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 0.00 | 100.00 | 200.00 | 300.00 | 2000.00 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 0.00 | 0.00 | 100.00 | 200.00 | 1500.00 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 0.00 | 0.00 | 75.00 | 150.00 | 1200.00 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 0.00 | 100.00 | 250.00 | 400.00 | 3000.00 |
| AHL Premium Express | 0.00 | 150.00 | 300.00 | 500.00 | 3000.00 |

## Tier observations

- AHL Spot Saver is the only product that charges even when cancelled two weeks or more ahead.
- The two contract-rated products charge nothing until fewer than seven days remain.
- The ceiling is a limit on the whole fee of one booking, not on the per-container rate.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A hypothetical AHL Contract Priority booking of 12 containers cancelled in the 0 to 2 day band would be priced at 150.00 per container, which is 1800.00 before the ceiling; the ceiling of 1200.00 for that product brings the fee down to 1200.00. The same booking in the 3 to 6 day band would be priced at 75.00 per container, 900.00 in all, which sits under the ceiling. The container count and the bands chosen are illustrative only.
